english.text: In this follow-up study, Tucker and her colleagues recruited men whose average age was about 75 years old. Over a period of four years, the researchers used a bone scanner to make regular measurements of the men's hips, spines and forearms. Tucker also had the men keep detailed information about what they ate. In particular, she asked about vitamin C, because vitamin C seems to slow down bone resorption.

jyutping: hai2 ni1 go3 gan1 zeon3 jin4 gau3 jap6 min6，taap3 hak1 tung4 keoi5 ge3 tung4 si6 ziu1 mou6 zo2 ping4 gwan1 nin4 ling4 daai6 joek3 75 seoi3 ge3 naam4 sing3。jin4 gau3 jan4 jyun4 hai2 sei3 nin4 ge3 si4 gaan3 leoi5 min6，jung6 gwat1 sou3 miu4 hei3 ding6 kei4 caak1 loeng4 naam4 si6 ge3 pet1 pet1、zek3 zeoi1 tung4 cin4 bei3。taap3 hak1 jik6 dou1 jiu3 di1 naam4 jan2 bou2 lau4 maai4 keoi5 dei6 sik6 zo2 di1 me1 ge3 coeng4 sai3 zi1 liu2，dak6 bit6 hai6 keoi5 man6 zo2 wai4 taa1 ming6 C，jan1 wai6 wai4 taa1 ming6 C ci5 fu4 wui5 gaam2 maan6 gwat1 gaak3 ge3 kap1 sau1。
text: 喺呢個跟進研究入面，塔克同佢嘅同事招募咗平均年齡大約75歲嘅男性。研究人員喺四年嘅時間裏面，用骨掃描器定期測量男士嘅噼噼、脊椎同前臂。塔克亦都要啲男人保留埋佢哋食咗啲咩嘅詳細資料，特別係佢問咗維他命C，因為維他命C似乎會減慢骨骼嘅吸收。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: I had a buffet lunch at an Indian restaurant called "La Tandoor." It was only $6.95 and it included spicy chicken curry and all sorts of curry. The dessert was rice pudding with pistachios. It was a heavy meal, but it was fabulous. A good thing that I notice of Indian restaurants is that the decor and the ambiance are very comfortable, almost like a bedroom. It makes me want to take a nap after the hearty meal. Today is the 3rd of November of 2001.

jyutping: ngo5 hai2 jat1 gaan1 giu3「 La Tandoor 」ge3 jan3 dou6 caan1 teng1 sik6 zo2 go3 zi6 zo6 ng5 caan1。zi2 hai6 $ 6.95，keoi5 baau1 zo2 naat3 gai1 gaa3 lei1 tung4 gok3 zung2 gaa3 lei1。tim4 ban2 hai6 hoi1 sam1 gwo2 mai5 bou3 ding1。ni1 go3 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 cung5 ge3 caan1，daan6 hai6 zan1 hai6 hou2 zeng3。ngo5 lau4 ji3 dou3 jan3 dou6 caan1 teng1 ge3 jat1 go3 hou2 cyu3 hai6，zong1 sau1 tung4 hei3 fan1 dou1 hou2 syu1 fuk6，caa1 m4 do1 hou2 ci5 seoi6 fong2 gam2。ling6 ngo5 sik6 jyun4 baau2 zi1 hau6 soeng2 fan3 gaau3。gam1 jat6 hai6 2001 nin4 11 jyut6 3 hou6。
text: 我喺一間叫「 La Tandoor 」嘅印度餐廳食咗個自助午餐。只係 $ 6.95，佢包咗辣雞咖喱同各種咖喱。甜品係開心果米布丁。呢個係一個好重嘅餐，但係真係好正。我留意到印度餐廳嘅一個好處係，裝修同氣氛都好舒服，差唔多好似睡房噉。令我食完飽之後想瞓覺。今日係2001年11月3號。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It's hot and sunny today, this 2nd of July of 2025, here on Lulu Island. I ventured walking to Tim Hortons café several times for the usual drinks and a Turkey Bacon Club Artisan Sandwich. I saw Michael L. J. the ufologist Dane-French on the way. He was wearing an ultramodern pair of sharp orange-tinted sunglasses. He was complaining about a snobby cashier at the gas station. On his cellphone, he showed me videos of flickering spooky bedroom lights that he attributes to extraterrestrials. He's thinking more of the famous Grey Aliens, but I tend to think that, instead, they may be postbiological. On my way home, I saw Robby, the neighbour Derek's Filipino uncle, in his car. He's Baptist like the rest of their family, still less common for Filipinos, mostly Roman Catholics.

text: 今日，呢個2025年7月2號，呢度露露島，天氣又熱又晴朗。 我冒險行咗幾次去 Tim Hortons 咖啡館飲平時嘅飲品同埋食火雞煙肉俱樂部嘅手工三文治。 我喺途中見到飛碟學家丹尼爾 - 法國人米高 L. J. 。 佢戴住一副超現代嘅鋒利橙色太陽眼鏡。 佢投訴緊油站有個冷酷嘅收銀員。 喺佢部手機，佢畀我睇咗啲閃閃發光嘅鬼怪睡房燈嘅影片，佢將呢啲燈歸因於外星人。佢諗緊嘅係出名嘅灰色外星人，但我傾向覺得，相反，佢哋可能係後生物。喺我返屋企嘅路上，我見到鄰居德里克嘅菲律賓叔叔羅比喺佢架車度。 佢同佢哋屋企其他人一樣係浸信會教徒，對菲律賓人嚟講仲係唔太常見，大多數都係羅馬天主教徒。
